item.title: Hantavirus: Media Hoax or Covid 2.0?
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes takes a look at what could be the next scamdemic: Hantavirus. Media reports have wildly blown the illness out of proportion. Does the World Health Organization really think people will fall for a new Covid 2.0? Or is this just a blip on the radar? Join guests Nurse Nicole, host of America Out Loud Radio, and Dr. Meryl Nass, a biological epidemiologist to discuss Hantavirus and the future of potential pandemics.

item.title: Belief, reverence, and the church: When faith and politics meet
item.description: What role does faith and belief have in politics? In the United States it is a major factor. Evangelicals have convinced themselves that a war in Iran is a Holy War, one written about in the scriptures. Add to that the strength of the Israel lobby, and we are looking at apocalyptic end times. Joining Scottie Nell Hughes on this episode of America First are Jake Shields, former champion fighter and prominent podcaster, and legal and media analyst Lionel. Don’t miss it!

item.title: Government bailouts: How tariffs end up giving huge taxpayer refunds to corporations
item.description: On this episode of America First , we dive deep into a new conspiracy surrounding tariffs. The Trump administration touted them as a way to fix trade imbalances. But then they were struck down. And guess who is lining up for refunds... corporations! It looks like another bailout for the big guy as the little guy suffers with more inflation. On this episode, Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by Scott Stantis, cartoonist for the Chicago Tribune, and Todd ‘Bubba’ Horwitz, chief market strategist for Bubbatrading.com.

item.title: America First & the climate agenda: Do they mix?
item.description: What does a climate policy look like under America First? Many believe that ‘green’ policies are about keeping the environment and populations healthy. Yet a serious critique of these policies has shown that very often, corporations benefit from them. So, does America First have a vision that incorporates green policies while also keeping in mind the working class? On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by Dr. Reese Halter, biologist and author, and independent journalist Justin Robert.

item.title: What does it mean to be America First?
item.description: What does it mean to be America First? This is the question splitting the right wing in the United States down the middle. Is America First the Maga movement as defined by Donald Trump? Or is America First moving more into the Tucker Carlson direction, opposed to any and all foreign interventions. Defining America First will determine the future of the right in America, and maybe the world, as well as determine the future of the US. On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by longtime conservative radio and TV pundits Steve Gill and Steve Malzberg.

item.title: Lack of accountability: Why do members of Congress get away with the unthinkable?
item.description: Eric Swalwell is out of Congress and no longer in the running for governor of California. But a new bombshell report shows there are 27 other congressional members who have sexual misconduct accusations against them. So, why has there been so little accountability? And why are we finding out about this now? On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by Miami Republican Committeewoman Angie Wong and Michael Wynne, Former US assistant attorney. Don’t miss this discussion as we explore term limits for Congress and the possibility of background checks for elected representatives.

item.title: Airborne catastrophe: Government shutdowns & TSA chaos at American airports
item.description: Government shutdowns are now a fairly common feature of American political life. But the average American takes notice when it starts to impact their daily life. Take the most recent shutdown and the inability of TSA workers to get paid. Americans are suffering with long lines at airports and missed flights. Is this now a permanent feature of the American experience? On this episode of America First, Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by radio hosts Shannon Joy and John Gordon, as well as business preparedness expert Keith Erwood to discuss shutdowns, the TSA, and President Trump’s popularity after having started a major war with Iran.
